title: Velvety Brothy Vietnamese Broccoli Pho
description: A rich, comforting, and lazy-sunday Vietnamese dish featuring broccoli, perfect for a homey individual meal in mini cocottes. This recipe is ayurvedic tamasic-friendly.

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.notes: bruise with a spoon for extra flavor

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until softened.
Add the ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the garlic and lemongrass and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Pour in the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the broth is rich and flavorful.
Meanwhile, melt the mantequilla in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the broccoli to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-5 minutes, or until tender but still crisp.
Stir the coconut milk into the beef broth and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
To assemble the pho, place a portion of the cooked broccoli in the bottom of a mini cocotte, then ladle the hot broth over the top, and top with the mantequilla and additional beef broth if desired.
